text:
alice: Quick thread — I put together a sketch for a prefix cache dashboard that breaks down hit-rate and token-saved by model, route, and customer. Want quick feedback before I spin up panels in Grafana.

ben: SGTM. can you include a delta view (7d vs 30d)? that helps spot regressions after deploys.

alice: yep. thinking panels: overall global hit-rate, per-model heatmap, per-route sparklines, top-20 customers by tokens saved, and a small table for recent deploys with before/after hit-rate diffs.

charlie: can we also surface cache key entropy / collision metric? last week we saw one customer with 40% of requests mapping to 3 keys.

alice: good call — add "cache_key_cardinality" and "top_key_share". also a signal for sudden drop in prefix match length (means shorter common prefixes).

ben: for deploy correlation: link the metrics to the rollout id / kernel selection change. maybe a panel tagging points when kernel-optimizer v2 landed.

alice: planned, will annotate the dashboard with release markers. sample PromQLs below. thoughts?

alice: ```
# global hit rate (tokens)
sum(prefix_cache_tokens_saved_total) / sum(tokens_generated_total)

# per-model hit rate
(sum by (model) (prefix_cache_tokens_saved_total{job="runtime"})) / (sum by (model) (tokens_generated_total{job="runtime"}))

# top customers by tokens saved (last 24h)
sort_desc(sum by (customer_id) (increase(prefix_cache_tokens_saved_total[24h])))

# cache key cardinality (unique keys seen per customer per hour)
count_values("key", prefix_cache_key_seen_total) by (customer_id)
```

dani: minor nit: prefix_cache_tokens_saved_total is cumulative and sometimes resets on pod restart — use increase(...[24h]) for panels. also add rate(...) for alerting.

alice: yes i'll use increase for panels. for alerts:

alice: ```
# alert: model-level hit-rate drop > 15% over 30m vs 24h baseline
(1 - (increase(prefix_cache_tokens_saved_total[30m]) / increase(tokens_generated_total[30m]))) /\
(1 - (increase(prefix_cache_tokens_saved_total[24h]) / increase(tokens_generated_total[24h]))) > 1.15
```

charlie: we should avoid dividing by zero. also maybe compute tokens_saved_per_request as a guardrail.

ben: UX: make a comparator dropdown for route and model; letting SREs pivot quickly. also include a small histogram of prefix lengths to detect warmup problems.

alice: adding prefix_length distribution:

alice: ```
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(prefix_match_length_bucket[5m])) by (le, model))
```

dani: regarding the regression we saw after kernel selector change — I dug traces and found the new batching heuristics produced different KV cache keys ordering for multistep prompts. that lowered key reuse by ~8% for model-x. we should show that on dashboard as a post-deploy annotation.

charlie: can we attach an example request id that demonstrates the keying difference? that would make it easier for runtime kernel folks to reproduce.

alice: yes — KV-bot can annotate a sample. @kv-bot can you dump one example where key_sequence before vs after differs?

kv-bot: sample_request_id: req_2026030123abcd
kv-bot: before_key_seq: [p1_hash, p2_hash, p3_hash]
kv-bot: after_key_seq: [p2_hash, p1_hash, p3_hash]
kv-bot: note: ordering change due to batching reordering in kernel-optimizer v2

ben: perfect. add a small timeline panel that overlays hit-rate and kernel-selector version.

alice: action items:
• build panels (global hit-rate, per-model heatmap, per-route sparklines, top customers table, prefix-length distribution, key-cardinality)
• add 7d/30d comparators and deploy annotations
• alert on >15% model-level hit-rate regression and >10% drop in tokens_saved_per_request
• attach sample_request_id(s) to annotations for regressions

charlie: would be good to add per-customer cache warmup time: time from first request to 90% of steady-state hit-rate. that helps guide warmup strategies (e.g., prefetch for large customers).

alice: added: customer_warmup_90pct metric idea — compute time_to_threshold against baseline window. will prototype a panel.

dani: one more — include a lightweight cost-savings estimate: tokens_saved * avg_token_cost / 1000 to show dollars. execs love this.

alice: yeah, panel for estimated $ saved. use per-model avg_token_cost linked from pricing table.

ben: last thought — granular permission: product folks can see model & route aggregated views, but customer-specific PII or IDs should be hidden by default. make a toggle.

alice: noted — will add RBAC filter. i'll spin up a draft dashboard and post the link when ready. thanks all. :thumbsup:

oncall_bot: Deploy notice: kernel-optimizer v2 rolled to 40% at 2026-03-01T18:12:04Z (rollout id ro-20260301-kv2) — annotated on timeline.

alice: thanks @oncall_bot — will validate the 40% sticky zone vs hit-rate delta.

ben: ping me when it's live, I'll add to the perf playbook and link the runbook steps.

alice: will do. closing out for now, will follow up with dashboard link + snapshot of last 7d vs 30d.
